description: This file contains shell functions related to upgrading Zyxel devices, including functions to retrieve root filesystem device, perform device flashing with tar archive contents, and upgrade procedure logic specific to Zyxel hardware.

methods.name: zyxel_get_rootfs
methods.description: Retrieves the root filesystem device from the kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: zyxel_do_flash
methods.description: Performs flashing of kernel and root filesystem from a tar archive to the device, including setup of loop devices and formatting.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade routine that determines device-specific parameters and calls the flash function, then performs a NAND upgrade.
